_doc: SYS-2: the code-agent ladder, cheapest first. Attempt N of a change uses rung N; the reviewer uses a different model. A rung is skipped when its route has no credential on the host. Prices are estimates in USD per million tokens (Workers AI is billed in neurons; these keep the cost log comparable). Read by foundation/agent_ladder.py, checked by `python3 -m foundation agent_ladder --check`.
